unsupported_model_diagnosis.quote: 正式入口运行在独立工作副本中，不会携带隐藏的 `.venv`，所以测试收集阶段仍找不到 `openpyxl`；这解释了失败原因。为满足“测试父进程和真实 CLI 子进程都使用项目依赖”，我会让自测在缺少项目 `.venv` 时自动在当前项目目录创建并安装它，然后父进程从该环境加载 `openpyxl`，CLI 子进程也使用同一解释器。生产程序不增加安装行为。
unsupported_model_diagnosis.assessment: The assertion that formal execution never carries .venv is not supported. Frozen baseline testing.py explicitly exposes the controlled package target after loading the trusted runner, and runner.py borrows an existing retained dependency environment. The missing reinstall in a new process and import-time bootstrap explain this trace; do not classify it as a broken environment implementation.

findings.trigger: Run formal collection without installed openpyxl and without an existing local venv interpreter.
findings.impact: Import-time venv creation/pip installation produces dependency outputs in the formal report-only execution. Two recorded attempts were blocked before any real test completed. Final package-path discovery does not remove this behavior.

findings.trigger: A .venv interpreter already exists but openpyxl is absent.
findings.impact: Bootstrap skips pip solely because the interpreter exists, so it cannot repair an incomplete venv. In addition line32 always prefers that venv for CLI children, even if the invoking Python had a working openpyxl installation. This is a static edge case, not a failure of the README fully installed path.
